note: Only captured_sha256 came across untouched. The capture's unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 is now ported additively (models/vit_swav.py, train_pretrain_vit_swav.py, configs/pretrain_vit.yaml, arch: vit) -- port-authored from the capture's train_step2_vit.py, mirroring ResNetSwAV so the native multi-crop loop is reused; the native ResNet-50 path is byte-for-byte unchanged. The checkpoint directory in the captured config was an absolute path on the cluster and is not shipped. The linear evaluation was added in a later port and reuses the captured evaluate_linear.py (recorded below).

rewritten_during_the_port.__init__.py: empty in the capture; kept empty
rewritten_during_the_port.evaluate_linear.py: captured sha256 01b266c9b3eb35ba833d26edf8c2d6376542a5cf05b2f7b7520155c3b03b1f1a. Added in the linear-evaluation port. resolve_device()/make_deterministic() imported from the trainer -- one implementation per method -- and the unconditional torch.device('cuda:gpu')/torch.cuda.set_device replaced; the captured evaluation could not start without a GPU. main() split into build_parser() and run(args, encoder, in_dim), which returns its metrics; the captured version wrote results.json and returned nothing. run() accepts an encoder built by the caller, because the contract's artifact is encoder.pt (the backbone alone) while the captured code rebuilds the whole model from a training checkpoint. in_dim is arch-aware: 2048 for the ResNet-50 backbone, the ViT's embed_dim for an arch: vit encoder built by build_vit_swav.
rewritten_during_the_port.configs/linear_eval.yaml: new: the linear-evaluation recipe as a contract config; model_type resnet is fixed by the adapter.
rewritten_during_the_port.models/__init__.py: the capture's file advertised a step-2 ViT through a lazy __getattr__ over a module absent from the capture snapshot -- a name the package could not import. Now a real lazy accessor: build_vit_swav builds the ported models/vit_swav.py (needs timm), imported lazily so the native ResNet-50 path never needs it.
rewritten_during_the_port.models/vit_swav.py: new, port-authored from the capture's train_step2_vit.py. A timm VisionTransformer (dynamic_img_size, num_classes=0) under self.encoder, a projection head (Linear->BN->ReLU->Linear, L2-normalised) and learnable prototypes (Linear, no bias). The list-of-crops forward mirrors ResNetSwAV -- groups crops by resolution, runs the shared backbone per group, concatenates, projects, scores against prototypes -- so the native multi-crop train_epoch/swav_loss/distributed_sinkhorn are reused unchanged. get_encoder() returns the CLS feature (encoder.pt is encoder.* alone).
rewritten_during_the_port.train_pretrain_vit_swav.py: new, port-authored from the capture's train_step2_vit.py. Single-process (DDP/torchrun dropped), device resolved, TensorBoard off. Builds ViTSwAV, reuses the native get_swav_dataloader and build_lr_schedule/set_lr/train_epoch, trains with AdamW (betas 0.9, 0.999) + warmup/cosine, and writes checkpoint_latest.pth plus checkpoint_epoch_{N}.pth at each save_at_epochs milestone (100/200/300).
rewritten_during_the_port.configs/pretrain_vit.yaml: new: the unified ViT-B/16 Step-2 recipe as a contract config (arch: vit). ViT-B/16 dims, projection head (768->2048->128), 3000 prototypes, multi-crop 2x224 + 6x96, AdamW + 10-epoch warmup/cosine to min_lr, save_at_epochs [100, 200, 300].
rewritten_during_the_port.data/__init__.py: the capture's file re-exported a step-2 loader absent from the capture snapshot; that dangling re-export is removed, since the ported ViT path reuses the native get_swav_dataloader
rewritten_during_the_port.train_pretrain_resnet.py: resolve_device() and make_deterministic() added, and the unconditional .cuda(local_rank) on the model and on each crop replaced by .to(device); the captured trainer could not start without a GPU. main() split into build_parser() and run(args, config), which returns the epoch loss and the epoch count; the captured version computed them and discarded them.
rewritten_during_the_port.data/multi_crop.py: captured sha256 c-- taken before the change. get_swav_dataloader built a DistributedSampler unconditionally, which needs an initialised process group, so this method could not run on one process at all -- on a GPU or otherwise. The sampler is now conditional, the same way every other ported method's loader already had it, and the trainer passes its own `distributed` flag through. Unlike the change the port before this one made and reverted, this one is for a failure that was observed: the run raised 'Default process group has not been initialized'.
